summary: Prepare two inverse operations for a binary tree. First turn the tree into one piece of text. Then rebuild, from that text, a tree with the same shape and the same node values. The empty tree must survive a full round trip. The node count lies between 0 and 104. The absolute value of every node value is at most 1000. Any text format is acceptable when the rebuilt tree matches the original. Implement both operations.
notes: Compare after trimming trailing newlines. The input is one command per line.
